# NASA Climate

> NASA's authoritative resource for climate science, Earth observation data, and satellite monitoring of environmental change.

Climate.nasa.gov provides access to NASA's Earth Science Division research on climate change, featuring real-time satellite monitoring, climate evidence, and comprehensive environmental data. The site serves researchers, educators, and the public seeking scientific insights into Earth's climate systems and global environmental trends.

## Key Topics

- climate-change
- earth-science
- satellite-monitoring
- NASA Earth Science Division

## Climate Monitoring & Data

- [Climate Change - NASA Science](https://climate.nasa.gov/earth-now/?event=eo_event_190402): NASA Earth Science Division's satellite monitoring of climate change and environmental data with real-time Earth observation capabilities.
